capabilities.title: ACCESS-VIEW LOG
capabilities.summary: record that a signed-in actor viewed a resource (append-only); an admin queries the trail (who viewed what, when) or a per-resource summary (views + distinct viewers).

capabilities.title: ACCOUNT HIERARCHY
capabilities.summary: a parent/child tree of org nodes (companies, departments, cost centers). An admin defines nodes; reads return a node's ancestors + direct children, its full descendant subtree, or the whole forest. Cycles are refused at write time; deleting a node reparents its children to its own parent.

capabilities.title: ACTIVITY / NOTES TIMELINE
capabilities.summary: a signed-in team member logs activities (note/call/email/meeting/task) against any entity (a contact, a deal) and reads the timeline. Team-internal (member auth required).

capabilities.title: ADDRESS FORMAT
capabilities.summary: a stateless postal-address formatter: assemble structured parts into the conventional multi-line layout for the country (US / GB / a sensible default).

capabilities.title: SAVED ADDRESSES / ADDRESS BOOK
capabilities.summary: a member keeps multiple postal addresses (shipping/billing) with exactly one default. Private per member (every op scoped to user_id — a foreign address is a 404).

routes.desc: {label?, name?, line1, line2?, city?, region?, postal?, country?, phone?, default?}
make it my default (atomic: exactly one)

capabilities.title: AGE GATE
capabilities.summary: a visitor submits a date of birth; the server computes the age and checks it against a minimum. For privacy only the computed age (never the raw DOB) is stored for signed-in members.

capabilities.title: ai
capabilities.summary: AI primitive — a built app asks the platform LLM a question. Metered to the app OWNER's credits (their visitors trigger it). Rate-limited hard.

capabilities.title: analytics
capabilities.summary: App-facing ANALYTICS read — the app's OWN admin reads back the traffic it fires with `/track` (page views + custom events), for an in-app "Analytics" dashboard. Aggregated daily counts from `_analytics` over a window, with a zero-filled day series for charts. → {total, from, to, byEvent:{ev:n}, byPath:[{path,n}], series:[{day,n}], events:[…]} ADMIN site-user only (traffic is business data). Separate from the isibi-owner dashboard.

capabilities.title: ANNOUNCEMENTS
capabilities.summary: an admin broadcasts a message; each member sees the ACTIVE ones until they dismiss.

capabilities.title: API-KEY SCOPES
capabilities.summary: attach a list of permission strings to a key so the app can gate what each key may do. Additive to /apikeys; stored in a `scopes` JSON column. Admin-only.

routes.desc: {label?,rpm?}  → {id, key:"sk_…", rpm} shown once (admin); rpm = per-key req/min cap

capabilities.title: APPROVAL QUORUM
capabilities.summary: an N-of-M sign-off. A request needs `needed` distinct approvers; each member approves once and when the count is reached the request flips to 'approved'. Distinct from /dual-approval (2-party maker/checker) — this is many-approver quorum.

capabilities.title: MARKETING ATTRIBUTION
capabilities.summary: record a member's touchpoints (channel + campaign); first/last-touch models attribute a conversion to the earliest or latest touch, and a report tallies channels across users.

routes.desc: {channel, campaign?, user?}   (member; admin may pass user)

capabilities.title: audit
capabilities.summary: Audit trail (ADMIN) — the write history of `audit:true` tables (+ impersonation events).

capabilities.title: AUDIT-LOG RETENTION
capabilities.summary: a singleton policy (retention_days) plus a prune that trims the audit trail older than the window; a bounded, self-serve GDPR/storage-hygiene control.

capabilities.title: auth
capabilities.summary: Two-factor auth (TOTP — authenticator apps). The signed-in member enrolls, confirms with a code to enable, and can disable. Once enabled, login requires a `code`.

capabilities.title: BADGES / ACHIEVEMENTS
capabilities.summary: an admin defines badges and awards them to members (once each); members read their own; anyone reads the badge catalog. `_badges` = definitions, `_badge_awards` = earned.

capabilities.title: WEIGHTED BALLOTS
capabilities.summary: a poll where each voter's choice carries a weight (voting power / shares); results tally the summed weight per option. Admin creates; members vote once (a re-vote replaces).

capabilities.title: TEMPORARY BAN LIST
capabilities.summary: an admin bans an arbitrary key (a user id, ip-hash, email…) until a time; a public check reports whether it's currently banned + seconds remaining. Expired bans read as not-banned.

capabilities.title: BARCODE
capabilities.summary: a stateless GTIN check-digit validator (EAN-13, UPC-A/12, EAN-8). The type is auto-detected from the length; the last digit is a mod-10 check.

capabilities.title: BASE64
capabilities.summary: a stateless base64 (and base64url) encoder / decoder for UTF-8 text.

capabilities.title: block
capabilities.summary: Blocks — hide another member. `POST /block/<userId>` toggles, `GET /block/<userId>` → {blocking}, `GET /blocks` → your blocked ids. Then pass `?hideBlocked=1` on a feed read to drop blocked authors. All auth-only (a block is personal).

capabilities.title: bom
capabilities.summary: BILL OF MATERIALS (ERP manufacturing) — a product's component recipe, multi-level, with recursive explosion. ADMIN-gated. Product/component keys are URL-safe SKUs.

routes.desc: {product, notes?, lines:[{component, qty}]}  → create/replace a BOM
list products that have a BOM

capabilities.title: SCHEDULING / BOOKINGS
capabilities.summary: book time slots on a resource with no double-booking. Any signed-in member books (owner-stamped); admin sees/manages all, members their own.

routes.desc: {resource, start, end, party?, ref?, note?}  → book (409 if it overlaps)

capabilities.title: BROADCAST FAN-OUT LOG
capabilities.summary: one row per broadcast send, tracking the recipient count + running sent/failed counts and status (sending -> done). A worker reports progress as it fans out.

capabilities.title: PRODUCT BUNDLES / KITS
capabilities.summary: a bundle groups component line items (qty × unit) and rolls up a total, minus an optional bundle discount.

routes.desc: {name, description?, currency?, discount?, active?, items:[{description, qty?, unit}]}  (ADMIN) → {id, subtotal, total}

capabilities.title: BUSINESS DAYS
capabilities.summary: a stateless working-day calculator: count business days between two dates (inclusive, skipping weekends + a holiday list), or find the date N business days after a start.

capabilities.title: CANNED RESPONSES
capabilities.summary: a staff-only library of reusable reply templates (keyed by slug) to paste into ticket answers. Entirely admin-scoped.

capabilities.title: CAPACITY FORECAST
capabilities.summary: a stateless capacity-vs-demand roll-up. Given periods of {capacity, demand}, it reports each period's utilization, shortfall (demand over capacity), and surplus, plus totals + overall utilization.

capabilities.title: CARD TYPE
capabilities.summary: a stateless card-brand detector from the number's IIN/prefix (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, Diners, JCB) plus a Luhn validity flag and expected-length check.

capabilities.title: cart
capabilities.summary: Shopping cart (private per member).

capabilities.title: CATEGORIES
capabilities.summary: a hierarchical taxonomy tree (blog/product categories, folders). An admin manages nodes; anyone reads the tree. parent_id builds the hierarchy; reparenting is cycle-guarded.

routes.desc: (ADMIN) → delete; children reparent to its parent

capabilities.title: CHALLENGES
capabilities.summary: a goal with a target + optional deadline; members log progress toward it, a board ranks them. Managing is admin; joining/progress is member; reading is public.

capabilities.title: CHANGELOG / RELEASE NOTES
capabilities.summary: an admin publishes versioned entries; the public reads the published ones newest-first.

capabilities.title: CHECKLISTS
capabilities.summary: a reusable checklist template (ordered items) + per-member completion. An admin defines the template; a member checks items off and reads their own progress. Public reads for the template itself.

capabilities.title: CHECKSUM
capabilities.summary: a stateless hash of a text payload (sha-256 default, sha-1, sha-512) for integrity checks or content de-duplication.

capabilities.title: COHORT RETENTION
capabilities.summary: record that a member was active on a day, then read a retention matrix: users are bucketed by the period (day/week/month) of their first activity, and each row shows what fraction of that cohort came back in each following period.

routes.desc: {day?, user?}   (member; admin may pass user) → record activity

capabilities.title: COLOR CONTRAST
capabilities.summary: a stateless WCAG contrast checker: given a foreground and background hex color, return the contrast ratio and AA / AAA pass flags (normal + large text).

capabilities.title: COLOR CONVERT
capabilities.summary: a stateless color converter between hex, rgb, and hsl. Accepts #hex, rgb(...), or hsl(...) and returns all three representations.

capabilities.title: COLOR PALETTE
capabilities.summary: a stateless palette generator from a base hex color. Schemes: complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, monochromatic (tints + shades). Returns hex colors derived via HSL rotation.

capabilities.title: comments
capabilities.summary: THREADED COMMENTS on any (table, row). A member posts a comment or a reply (parent_id); anyone READS a row's thread (public, like feed/display rows); a member edits/soft-deletes their OWN; an admin deletes any. Soft-delete leaves a tombstone ONLY if the comment still has replies (thread stays intact), else it's omitted; the count excludes soft-deleted.

capabilities.title: COMMISSION
capabilities.summary: a stateless commission calculator. Flat (`rate`, a fraction like 0.1 = 10%) OR marginal tiers (`tiers:[{upto, rate}]`, sorted; the last tier may omit `upto` for "everything above"). Returns the commission, an effective rate, and a per-bracket breakdown. Amounts are numbers; commission rounds to cents.

capabilities.title: COMPARISON SETS
capabilities.summary: a member builds named sets of item references to compare side-by-side (a "compare tray").

capabilities.title: config
capabilities.summary: App settings / config KV — public READ (the app renders from it), ADMIN-only WRITE.

capabilities.title: CONFIG VALIDATION
capabilities.summary: a stateless validator for a single config object against a typed schema (type, required, default, enum, min/max); returns per-key errors AND a normalized object with defaults applied. → {valid, errors:[{key,message}], normalized}

capabilities.title: CONTACT ENRICHMENT
capabilities.summary: a supplementary key/value field store per contact (firmographics, source, tags…), kept out of the main contact record. Admin writes; admin reads one contact's fields or finds contacts by a field value (segmentation).

capabilities.title: contacts
capabilities.summary: CONTACTS (CRM) — an admin-managed address book. Capturing the same email fills gaps on the existing row instead of creating a duplicate; merge folds one contact into another (the loser keeps merged_into).

routes.desc: {email?, name?, phone?, company?, tags?, notes?}  (ADMIN) → dedupe-capture

capabilities.title: CONTENT-HASH DEDUP
capabilities.summary: a SHA-256 fingerprint of submitted content; the first submission is recorded, later identical content is flagged as a duplicate (with when + who first saw it, and a running hit count).

capabilities.title: CONTENT REVIEW WORKFLOW
capabilities.summary: a content item moves draft → in_review → approved | rejected, and approved → published; each transition is an atomic state-guarded UPDATE. Author owns draft/submit; admin reviews.

capabilities.title: GOAL / CONVERSION TRACKING
capabilities.summary: a named goal counts visits and conversions; the rate is derived.

capabilities.title: UNIT CONVERTER
capabilities.summary: a stateless converter across length / mass / volume / time / data / temperature. The category is auto-detected from the units; conversion goes through a base unit (temperature is special).

capabilities.title: count
capabilities.summary: Named counters — likes / views / reactions / poll tallies. Public + atomic. at 0), returns {value}. GET /count/<name> → {value}. GET /count → all.

capabilities.title: COUNTDOWN / LAUNCH TIMERS
capabilities.summary: an admin sets a named target datetime; the app reads seconds remaining.

capabilities.title: APP COUNTERS / METRICS
capabilities.summary: named integer counters incremented ATOMICALLY (page hits, tallies, a cached count). Reads public; incrementing needs a signed-in member; set/delete are admin.

capabilities.title: coupon
capabilities.summary: Coupons / discount codes.

capabilities.title: courses
capabilities.summary: PROGRESS / COMPLETION TRACKING (LMS) — a course's items, a learner's completion %, and prerequisite gating. Course def is ADMIN; a signed-in member records/reads their OWN progress (admin can act for any `learner`).

routes.desc: {item, learner?, score?}  → mark done (409 if prereq unmet)
{item?, learner?}            → un-complete an item / whole course

capabilities.title: PER-CUSTOMER CREDIT LIMIT
capabilities.summary: an admin sets a member's credit line; charges draw it down (never past the limit), payments pay it back. Balance is kept in cents, one row per user. All admin except a member reading their own line.

routes.desc: {amount} (ADMIN)  → add a charge (409 if over limit)

capabilities.title: CRON PREVIEW
capabilities.summary: a stateless "when does this cron next fire?" helper for standard 5-field cron expressions (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week; supports * , - and /). Returns the next N fire times (UTC).

capabilities.title: CSV CONVERTER
capabilities.summary: a stateless two-way converter between JSON rows and CSV text (RFC-4180 quoting), so an app can build an export or parse a paste without a client-side library.

capabilities.title: CURRENCY FORMAT
capabilities.summary: a stateless money formatter using Intl: an amount + ISO currency (+ optional locale) → the localized string, symbol, and minor-unit digits.

capabilities.title: DAILY-REWARD CLAIM
capabilities.summary: a member claims once per UTC day; consecutive-day claims grow a streak (a missed day resets it). The response reports the streak + a reward amount (the app grants it).

routes.desc: (member) → {claimed, streak, day, reward} · 409 if already today

capabilities.title: PER-USER DASHBOARD TILES
capabilities.summary: each member stores their own dashboard layout (a JSON blob of tiles). PUT/POST /api/db/<slug>/dashboard {tiles} (member) → save

capabilities.title: DATA EXPORT
capabilities.summary: a member downloads a bundle of all their OWN data across the site's user-scoped tables (GDPR data portability). Only the caller's own rows are ever returned.

capabilities.title: deals
capabilities.summary: DEAL PIPELINE (kanban) — sales deals move across stages; a board view groups them by stage + totals.

capabilities.title: DEPOSIT HOLDS
capabilities.summary: a refundable deposit placed against a booking/order, later CAPTURED (kept) or RELEASED (refunded). State machine held -> captured | released; each transition is atomic (a resolved hold can't change again). Amount in cents. Admin manages; a member may read their own hold.

routes.desc: {amount, ref?, user?, reason?}  (ADMIN)  → place a hold

capabilities.title: TEXT DIFF
capabilities.summary: a stateless line-level diff (LCS) of two texts: a sequence of {type:'eq'|'add'|'del', line} plus added/removed counts. For a 'what changed' view or a review UI.

capabilities.title: SCHEDULED DIGESTS
capabilities.summary: an admin defines a named digest (a saved query + a cadence); a due-list surfaces the ones whose next_run has passed to send, then marks them sent (advancing next_run).

routes.desc: {description?, query?, interval_days, recipients?, start?, active?}  (ADMIN) → upsert
(ADMIN) → active digests whose next_run has passed

capabilities.title: DISCOUNT STACK
capabilities.summary: a stateless evaluator for whether/how multiple discounts combine. Each discount is {code, type:'percent'|'fixed', value, stackable?}. All `stackable:true` discounts apply together (percents compound on the running total, fixed subtract); each non-stackable is considered ALONE. The result is the combination that yields the LOWEST price. Money in cents.

capabilities.title: dm
capabilities.summary: DIRECT MESSAGES (social) — 1:1 conversations between members. Signed-in; only the two participants see a thread.

routes.desc: mark incoming from that member read

capabilities.title: AR/AP AGING
capabilities.summary: open documents of a type bucketed by how overdue they are, for a receivables/payables report. Uses due_date (falls back to doc_date). ADMIN-gated. → {as_of, buckets:[…labels], parties:[{party, total, aged:[…]}], totals:{aged:[…], total}}

routes.desc: {type, party?, date?, currency?, ref?, memo?, status?, number?, lines:[{item?,description?,qty,unit_price,tax_rate?,dim?,meta?}]} → {doc}
{…header, lines?}  → update header; lines only replaceable while 'draft'
{type, status?, date?, source_status?} → copy lines into a new linked doc

capabilities.title: DOWNLOADS
capabilities.summary: a per-file download counter (optionally gated to signed-in members).

routes.desc: (public · member if gated) → count + return the url

capabilities.title: TWO-PERSON APPROVAL
capabilities.summary: a sensitive op needs TWO distinct admins to sign off. One admin proposes, a DIFFERENT admin approves (or any admin rejects).

capabilities.title: DUNNING
capabilities.summary: a failed-payment retry state machine. A case opens 'active' after a failed charge; each recorded attempt recovers it (success) or schedules the next retry until max_attempts is hit ('failed'). Amount cents.

routes.desc: {ref, amount?, user?, max_attempts?, retry_days?}  (ADMIN) → open a case

capabilities.title: effective
capabilities.summary: EFFECTIVE-DATED RECORDS (HCM/pricing history) — a value that changes over time; query it "as of" any date. ADMIN-gated. `value` is any JSON.

routes.desc: {subject, attribute, effective_date, value, note?}  → record a change
value as of a date (omit as_of → full history)
every subject's value as of a date

capabilities.title: EMBED CACHE
capabilities.summary: cache embed/oEmbed metadata (html/title/thumbnail) per URL so the app renders a rich embed without re-fetching. Caching is member-write, reading is public.

capabilities.title: entitlements
capabilities.summary: ENTITLEMENTS / SUBSCRIPTIONS (commerce) — per-account plan/feature state + expiry. Grants are ADMIN (server-authoritative); a member checks/reads their OWN, admin any.

routes.desc: {account, feature?, plan?, status?, starts?, expires?, meta?}  (admin) upsert

capabilities.title: ENTITY FIELDS
capabilities.summary: a flexible key/value enrichment store: attach admin-managed extra attributes to any record identified by (type, id) without a schema change. Admin writes; signed-in members read. POST/PUT /api/db/<slug>/entity-fields/<type>/<id> {fields:{k:v,...}} (ADMIN) → upsert fields

capabilities.title: ENVIRONMENT CONFIG
capabilities.summary: key/value settings scoped to a named environment (dev / staging / prod), plus a promote action that copies values from one environment to another. Admin-only.

capabilities.title: EQUIPMENT / ASSET CHECKOUT
capabilities.summary: atomically check an asset out (only if available), return it, and log every move. A member holds one asset at a time per item; the current holder or an admin returns it.

capabilities.title: RIGHT-TO-BE-FORGOTTEN QUEUE
capabilities.summary: a member opens a data-erasure request; an admin moves it open → processing → done | rejected. Each transition is an atomic state-guarded UPDATE.

capabilities.title: ESCALATION RULES
capabilities.summary: an admin defines rules (after N minutes, escalate to a target); an evaluate call returns the rule that applies to a given elapsed time (the highest after_mins that has passed).

capabilities.title: EVENT LOG / STREAM
capabilities.summary: an append-only stream of typed events with a monotonic id; readers tail it with an `after` cursor. Distinct from the CRUD-focused audit log.

capabilities.title: events
capabilities.summary: EVENT REGISTRATION with a hard CAPACITY (ticketed events, class signups, limited slots). An admin defines the event + capacity; a member registers and the seat vs waitlist decision is made by a SINGLE atomic INSERT (the cap is never exceeded under concurrency); cancelling a seat atomically promotes the front of the waitlist. Distinct from /waitlist (unbounded queue) and /reactions RSVP.

routes.desc: cancel mine; promotes the next waitlisted

capabilities.title: EXCERPT
capabilities.summary: a stateless smart truncator: optionally strip HTML, collapse whitespace, then cut to N words or N characters on a word boundary, appending an ellipsis when the text was shortened.

capabilities.title: EXPENSE CLAIMS
capabilities.summary: a member submits an expense; an admin moves it submitted → approved | rejected, and approved → reimbursed. Each transition is an atomic state-guarded UPDATE.

capabilities.title: experiment
capabilities.summary: Mentions → notifications — a member @mentions others in a post/comment; the app detects the handles client-side and calls this with the mentioned user ids, which drops a "mention" notification into each one's inbox. Capped (≤10/call), rate-limited, and deduped per (recipient, target) within an hour so it can't be used to spam. A/B testing / experiments — deterministically bucket a visitor into a variant and track conversions. GET /api/db/<slug>/experiment/<name>?variants=a,b[&key=] → {variant} (stable per user_key: the signed-in member, or a passed `key`); POST …/convert marks a conversion; GET …/results (admin) → per-variant exposures + conversions + rate.

capabilities.title: A/B EXPERIMENTS
capabilities.summary: an admin defines an experiment with weighted variants; a member is assigned a variant DETERMINISTICALLY (sticky, weighted by a hash of key:userId), the exposure + any conversion are recorded, and the admin reads per-variant results. Complements /flags (on/off) with multi-variant + conversion measurement.

capabilities.title: export
capabilities.summary: Full-site export (ADMIN) — download EVERY app table's rows in one JSON bundle, so a generated app can offer its own admin a "Download all data" backup button (the per-table export below only does one table at a time). Members are included with safe columns only (never password hashes). Owner-scoped user/feed data is NOT filtered — an app admin sees the whole dataset by design (it's their site's data).

capabilities.title: FAQ / KNOWLEDGE BASE
capabilities.summary: admin-managed Q&A; the public reads the published entries (with search + category filter). Reads are public; managing is admin.

capabilities.title: feed
capabilities.summary: HOME FEED (social) — a timeline of rows in a user/feed table owned by the accounts the caller follows, newest-first. Keyset via `before` (an id). Requires the follow graph.

capabilities.title: FEEDBACK BOARD
capabilities.summary: members submit ideas/requests, everyone upvotes, staff set a roadmap status.

capabilities.title: finance
capabilities.summary: FINANCE CALCULATORS (ERP) — stateless, touch no data (any signed-in member). → {method, cost, salvage, life, total_depreciable, schedule:[{period, date?, depreciation, accumulated, book_value}]}

capabilities.title: FLAG ATTRIBUTE AUDIENCES
capabilities.summary: target a feature flag by arbitrary user attributes (plan=pro, country=US). Rules are {attr: [allowed values]} stored on the flag; `match` tests a supplied attribute bag against them AND the flag's enabled state. Kept off the /flags path (its catch-all matcher would swallow this).

capabilities.title: FEATURE FLAGS
capabilities.summary: an admin configures flags; each member evaluates which are on for THEM (enabled + role targeting + deterministic % rollout, so a gradual rollout is stable per user).

routes.desc: {key, enabled?, rollout?(0-100), roles?[], teams?[], value?}  (ADMIN upsert)

capabilities.title: follow
capabilities.summary: Follows — the member social graph. Toggle a follow, read a member's followers/following counts (+ whether the caller follows them), and list either side for a "Followers"/"Following" page.

capabilities.title: OPPORTUNITY FORECAST CATEGORIES
capabilities.summary: sales deals tagged with a forecast category (pipeline / best_case / commit / closed / omitted) + amount, rolled up per category into a forecast. One row per ref.

routes.desc: {ref, amount, category, name?, period?}  (ADMIN) → upsert a deal

capabilities.title: CONTACT FREQUENCY CAP
capabilities.summary: limit how many messages a specific recipient receives per window (contact fatigue), with the cap + window supplied per call. Atomic per (recipient|channel, window). → {allowed, remaining, reset_at}

capabilities.title: CONVERSION FUNNEL
capabilities.summary: how many distinct actors made it through an ordered set of steps (signup → activate → purchase). Computed over the app's OWN event-log table: rows that record a step per actor. For each step k, counts distinct actors who did steps[0..k] (all of them, within the window) — a monotonic funnel with per-step drop-off. → {steps:[{step, count, pct_of_top, pct_of_prev}], overall_conversion, …} ADMIN site-user only (reads across every actor's rows).

capabilities.title: CURRENCY CONVERSION SNAPSHOT
capabilities.summary: an admin stores exchange rates (relative to a base); the app converts an amount between currencies at the stored rates. PUT/POST /api/db/<slug>/fx {base?, rates:{USD:1, EUR:0.92, …}} (ADMIN) → replace the rate table

capabilities.title: GEO DISTANCE
capabilities.summary: a stateless point-to-point great-circle (haversine) distance + initial bearing between two coordinates. (For a nearby-rows search, a table can declare `geo` instead.)

capabilities.title: GEOFENCE
capabilities.summary: a stateless point-in-region test. The fence is a circle {center,radius_m}, a bounding box {min_lat,min_lon,max_lat,max_lon}, or a polygon {points:[{lat,lon}]}. Returns whether the point is inside (and, for a circle, the distance to the center).

capabilities.title: GIFT CARDS
capabilities.summary: a code-bearer stored-value card: an admin issues one with a balance; anyone with the code checks or redeems against it (never below zero).

capabilities.title: GIFT REGISTRY
capabilities.summary: an owner lists wanted items; others atomically claim a quantity so nothing is bought twice (the guard is a single conditional INSERT — a would-be over-claim is refused). The owner is not told who claimed, only how many remain.

routes.desc: {title, url?, price?, qty?}   (member) → add to my registry

capabilities.title: GIVEAWAY / SWEEPSTAKES
capabilities.summary: members enter an open giveaway (once each), an admin randomly draws winners.

capabilities.title: GLOSSARY
capabilities.summary: an admin curates terms + definitions (with aliases); the app looks a term up (by term or alias) and lists/searches them. Keyed by the lowercased term.

capabilities.title: goals
capabilities.summary: FUNDRAISING / GOAL PROGRESS (a crowdfunding thermometer, a tip jar, a pledge drive). An admin sets a goal + target; members contribute amounts that sum toward it; the public sees raised + progress. Money is integer cents. Contributions are append-only. The per-contributor amounts are ADMIN-only (the public read is aggregate); a member sees only the totals.

capabilities.title: SLUG / HANDLE RESERVATION
capabilities.summary: atomically claim a unique handle inside a namespace, tied to the member who claimed it, so no two people can grab the same one under concurrency.

routes.desc: {handle, ns?}   (member) → claim; 409 if taken by someone else

capabilities.title: HEALTH-CHECK REGISTRY
capabilities.summary: named checks each report up / degraded / down; a public read rolls them into one overall status (down beats degraded beats up).

capabilities.title: HELP-ARTICLE VOTES
capabilities.summary: a member marks a help/FAQ article helpful (yes) or not (no); the aggregate drives a "N of M found this helpful" widget. One changeable vote per (article, member).

capabilities.title: BUSINESS HOURS
capabilities.summary: weekly open intervals (per day-of-week, local time) + per-date overrides (holidays / special hours), and an "open now?" check. Reads public; managing is admin. Times are local minutes-since-midnight; the open-check takes the business's tz offset (minutes from UTC).

routes.desc: {dow(0-6), open, close}   (ADMIN) → add an open interval → {id}
{date, closed?, open?, close?, note?}  (ADMIN) → a date override

capabilities.title: HUMANIZE
capabilities.summary: a stateless human-friendly formatter for bytes, durations, counts, ordinals, and relative time. Turn raw numbers/timestamps into display strings. type: bytes | duration | number | ordinal | relative

capabilities.title: i18n
capabilities.summary: LOCALIZATION / i18n (CMS) — the same string/content in many languages, with fallback. Reads are PUBLIC (a multilingual site renders to anonymous visitors, like /config); writes are ADMIN. A `fallback` locale fills any key missing in the requested locale.

routes.desc: {namespace?, locale, entries:{key:value}}  OR  {namespace?, key, locale, value}  (admin)

capabilities.title: IBAN
capabilities.summary: a stateless IBAN validator (length-by-country + the ISO 7064 mod-97 checksum). Spaces are ignored.

capabilities.title: ical
capabilities.summary: iCALENDAR FEED — a stateless generator: turn a list of events into a downloadable .ics (VCALENDAR) a user can subscribe to or import into Google/Apple Calendar. Sibling to the RSS/sitemap generators. (public) → text/calendar

routes.desc: {events:[{uid?, title, start, end?, description?, location?, allDay?}], name?}

capabilities.title: ID GENERATE
capabilities.summary: a stateless ID generator: uuid v4, a ULID-style time-sortable id, a short base62 id, or a url-safe token. Optionally batch and prefix.

capabilities.title: IDEMPOTENCY KEYS
capabilities.summary: safe retries. A caller stamps a write with a key; the FIRST call stores its result, a REPLAY returns the stored result without re-running. Per (user_id, key), atomic claim.

capabilities.title: import
capabilities.summary: CSV import (ADMIN) — bulk-load a spreadsheet into a table, with optional column mapping. Complements the export. Only declared columns are written; unknown/extra CSV columns are ignored; each row is validated. `mapping` maps CSV-header → table-col (default: headers that match a declared column auto-map).

capabilities.title: BULK IMPORT VALIDATION PREVIEW
capabilities.summary: a stateless dry-run: given a field spec and candidate rows, report per-row validation errors (missing required, wrong type, unknown column) WITHOUT writing anything, so a CSV/paste import can be checked before it commits. → {total, valid, invalid, results:[{index, ok, errors:[{field,message}]}]}

capabilities.title: STATUS-PAGE INCIDENTS
capabilities.summary: staff post service incidents with a timeline of updates; the public reads them + can subscribe an email. Managing is admin; reading + subscribing is public.

capabilities.title: INVENTORY COUNT
capabilities.summary: a stock-take / cycle-count log: record a physical count of a SKU vs the expected on-hand, capture the variance, and reconcile it. Independent of the live stock ledger. Admin-only.

routes.desc: {sku, expected, counted, note?}  (ADMIN) → record a count

capabilities.title: inventory-lots
capabilities.summary: INVENTORY LOTS (FEFO) — batch/lot stock with expiry; issuing consumes the earliest-expiring lots first. Each per-lot decrement is a guarded UPDATE; a multi-lot issue pre-checks the total and refunds on a race.

routes.desc: {sku, lot?, qty, expires?}   (ADMIN) → receive a lot

capabilities.title: IP ALLOW/DENY LIST
capabilities.summary: an admin maintains allow/deny rules; a check tells whether an IP is permitted (an explicit deny always blocks; if ANY allow rules exist it becomes an allowlist).

routes.desc: {ip, action, note?}  (ADMIN) → add/update a rule (action allow|deny)

capabilities.title: ISBN
capabilities.summary: a stateless ISBN-10 / ISBN-13 validator (check-digit) with cross-conversion. Hyphens/spaces ignored.

capabilities.title: BACKGROUND JOB QUEUE
capabilities.summary: enqueue jobs, atomically claim the next due one (claim bumps attempts), then mark done or failed; a failure re-queues with backoff until max_attempts, after which it goes 'dead'. Admin.

capabilities.title: KPI SNAPSHOTS
capabilities.summary: record a business metric (MRR, active users, NPS…) at points in time and read back the trend + deltas. Append-only; the app decides what to snapshot and when.

routes.desc: {metric, value, at?, note?}   → record a snapshot (admin)

capabilities.title: KUDOS / PEER RECOGNITION
capabilities.summary: a member gives kudos to another member; a leaderboard ranks top receivers.

capabilities.title: GENERIC LEADERBOARDS
capabilities.summary: a named board over any metric; members submit scores under a per-board mode (max = keep best · sum = accumulate · last = latest); reads return the ranked top-N (+ my rank).

capabilities.title: LEAD CAPTURE + SCORING
capabilities.summary: a public web form captures a prospect; staff triage, score, and own it.

capabilities.title: leave
capabilities.summary: LEAVE / PTO BALANCES (ERP HR) — accrual/taking ledger + balances. ADMIN-gated.

routes.desc: {employee, leave_type?, days(+accrue/−take), kind?, ref?, note?, date?, allowNegative?}

capabilities.title: ledger
capabilities.summary: DOUBLE-ENTRY LEDGER (ERP finance) — a balanced, append-only, immutable general journal. ADMIN-gated (finance). One DB can hold several named ledgers via ?ledger= (default 'gl'). → posts a balanced entry (Σdebit=Σcredit) → {entry}

capabilities.title: LEVELS / XP LADDER
capabilities.summary: an admin defines level thresholds; the app resolves an XP amount (or a member's points balance) to a level + progress toward the next. PUT/POST /api/db/<slug>/levels {tiers:[{level, name?, min_xp}]} (ADMIN) → replace the ladder

routes.desc: (member) → the caller's level from their points balance

capabilities.title: LICENSE KEYS
capabilities.summary: an admin issues a license key (product/owner/seats/expiry); anyone validates a key; an admin revokes it.

capabilities.title: link
capabilities.summary: Many-to-many links between rows (targets are `<table>:<id>`).

capabilities.title: BROKEN-LINK REGISTRY
capabilities.summary: track URLs and record the last result an external checker reported (ok / broken). The server does NOT fetch the URLs; a crawler posts results. Admin-only.

capabilities.title: NAMED LISTS / COLLECTIONS
capabilities.summary: a member curates named lists (wishlist, watchlist, playlist, saved items) whose items reference rows in any table. Private by default; a list can be made public to share. Every list/item op is scoped to the owner (a public list is read-only to non-owners).

routes.desc: a list + its items (owner, or if public)
{table?, row?, note?, sort?}  → add an item (owner)

capabilities.title: LOYALTY TIERS
capabilities.summary: an admin defines spend thresholds with benefits; a member's running spend resolves to a tier + progress toward the next. PUT/POST /api/db/<slug>/loyalty/tiers {tiers:[{tier, name?, min_spend, benefits?}]} (ADMIN) → replace

capabilities.title: LUHN
capabilities.summary: a stateless Luhn (mod-10) checksum validator for card / account / ID numbers, plus the check digit that would make a partial number valid.

capabilities.title: MAINTENANCE SCHEDULE
capabilities.summary: an asset with a recurring service interval; marking it serviced advances the next-due date, and a check flags overdue items. One row per key. `next_due` is computed server-side.

capabilities.title: MARKDOWN → SANITIZED HTML
capabilities.summary: a stateless renderer for a safe Markdown subset. ALL input is HTML-escaped first, so no raw HTML/script can pass through; only a known set of tags is emitted. Supports headings, bold/italic, inline + fenced code, links (http/https/mailto only), ul/ol lists, blockquotes, hr, paragraphs.

capabilities.title: MASK
capabilities.summary: a stateless PII masker: hide most of a value while keeping just enough to recognise it (email, phone, card, or a generic keep-last-N).

capabilities.title: MEDIA LIBRARY METADATA
capabilities.summary: alt text / caption / credit / tags / dimensions for a media asset, keyed by its URL or id, so descriptive metadata travels with the file.

routes.desc: {key, alt?, caption?, credit?, tags?, width?, height?}  (ADMIN) → upsert

capabilities.title: mentions
capabilities.summary: @MENTIONS — a member records that another member was @-tagged; the MENTIONED member reads THEIR OWN mentions and marks them seen. Privacy/IDOR: every read/mutate is scoped to mentioned_user = caller; a member never sees the by_user perspective.

capabilities.title: NAVIGATION / MENU BUILDER
capabilities.summary: an admin builds named menus (header/footer/sidebar) of ordered, nestable items; the app reads a whole menu as a nested tree. Managing is admin; reading is public.

routes.desc: (public) → the menu as a nested tree

capabilities.title: METRIC ALERTS
capabilities.summary: declare threshold rules on named metrics, then push a value through `check` to evaluate them and log any breach. Admin-only.

routes.desc: {metric, op, threshold, note?}   (ADMIN) → define a rule

capabilities.title: MILESTONES
capabilities.summary: an admin defines personal progression milestones (a numeric target); each member accrues progress and achieves it. Distinct from /challenges (group goals with a shared board + deadline).

capabilities.title: MIME DETECT
capabilities.summary: a stateless magic-byte content-type sniffer. Give it the first bytes as base64 (or hex) and it returns the detected MIME type, a file extension, and a coarse category. Never trusts a filename.

capabilities.title: MRP
capabilities.summary: material requirements planning: explode a basket of demand, aggregate leaf component needs, net against on-hand availability → shortfalls to buy/build. ADMIN.

capabilities.title: NEWSLETTER DOUBLE OPT-IN
capabilities.summary: a visitor subscribes (pending + a confirm token), confirms via the token, and can unsubscribe. The token is returned so the app can email it.

capabilities.title: NO-SHOW TRACKING
capabilities.summary: record when a member misses a booking; the strike count is COUNT per user. Admin records/forgives; a member sees their own.

capabilities.title: REPLAY-PROTECTION NONCES
capabilities.summary: consume a single-use token exactly once (atomic). A repeat is a replay.

capabilities.title: notifications
capabilities.summary: In-app notification inbox (the signed-in member's OWN notifications):

capabilities.title: BACK-IN-STOCK / PRICE-DROP NOTIFY
capabilities.summary: a visitor asks to be told when an item is available/cheaper; the admin lists pending subscribers and fires them (marking them notified so nobody is emailed twice).

routes.desc: {kind?}     (ADMIN) → mark pending notified → the list to email

capabilities.title: NOTIFICATION PREFERENCES + QUIET HOURS
capabilities.summary: a member controls which channels/types they receive and a do-not-disturb window; the app asks /should-send before notifying. Per-member and private (a member reads/writes their OWN; an admin may check any member's send-eligibility with &user=).

routes.desc: {channels?, types?, quiet_start?, quiet_end?, tz_offset?}  → update mine

capabilities.title: NPS SURVEYS
capabilities.summary: a member answers a 0–10 'how likely to recommend' once per campaign; the score endpoint buckets promoters (9–10) / passives (7–8) / detractors (0–6) and returns NPS = %promoters − %detractors.

capabilities.title: NUMBER TO WORDS
capabilities.summary: a stateless integer/money speller (English). With `currency` it spells an amount ("one hundred twenty-three dollars and forty-five cents"); otherwise it spells the whole number.

capabilities.title: ONBOARDING CHECKLIST
capabilities.summary: an admin defines steps; each member marks them done and reads their progress.

capabilities.title: ON-CALL ROTATION
capabilities.summary: an ordered member list that rotates on a fixed interval; `current` is computed deterministically from the anchor time, so there's no pointer to advance. PUT/POST /api/db/<slug>/oncall/<rotation> {members:[...], interval_sec, anchor?} (ADMIN) → define

capabilities.title: DOUBLE OPT-IN
capabilities.summary: an email subscribes (pending + a token) and must confirm via the token before it counts.

routes.desc: {email, list?}     (public) → {token} to email as a confirm link

capabilities.title: ORDER NOTES / GIFT MESSAGES
capabilities.summary: a member attaches a note or a gift message to an order reference; staff read them all.

routes.desc: (member: own on that order; admin: all)

capabilities.title: otp
capabilities.summary: ONE-TIME CODES (OTP) — verify a short code for a purpose+identifier (confirm a phone/email, approve a sensitive action). /generate makes a code (returned ONCE so the APP can send it via SMS/email), stores it HASHED with an expiry + attempt cap; /verify checks it (single-use). One active code per (purpose, identifier). Any signed-in member; the app is responsible for sending it to the right place.

capabilities.title: PASSWORD POLICY
capabilities.summary: a site-configurable password rule set (a singleton) plus a check. Admin sets the rules; the current rules are public (so a signup form can show them) and a check validates a candidate password.

routes.desc: {min_length?, require_upper?, require_lower?, require_digit?, require_symbol?, min_classes?, disallow_common?}  (ADMIN) → set

capabilities.title: PASSWORD STRENGTH
capabilities.summary: a stateless meter: score a candidate password 0–4 with a label and actionable suggestions. Nothing is stored or logged.

capabilities.title: periods
capabilities.summary: FISCAL PERIODS / period close (ERP finance) — freeze the ledger through a date so finalized books can't be altered by a backdated post. ADMIN-gated.

routes.desc: {through}  → close the books through this date (lock)
[{through}] → reopen (clear the lock, or move it earlier)

capabilities.title: PETITIONS
capabilities.summary: a signature drive toward a goal; a member signs once. Reading is public.

capabilities.title: PHONE NORMALIZE
capabilities.summary: a stateless best-effort E.164 normalizer. A leading + is trusted; otherwise a country (ISO2 or dialing code) supplies the prefix and a leading national 0 is stripped. Not a full validator.

capabilities.title: PLURALIZE
capabilities.summary: a stateless English inflector: returns the singular + plural of a word and, with a `count`, the correctly-inflected form and a "N words" phrase. Handles common irregulars + suffix rules.

capabilities.title: POINTS / KARMA LEDGER
capabilities.summary: a per-member gamification points balance backed by an append-only ledger.

capabilities.title: poll
capabilities.summary: Polls — one vote per member (change by re-voting). Poll + options are app strings.

capabilities.title: BACKORDER / PREORDER CAPACITY HOLDS
capabilities.summary: an admin caps how many units can be reserved; a member holds a quantity and the cap can't be exceeded under concurrency.

routes.desc: {qty?}  (member) → reserve qty → {held, remaining} · 409 if over cap

capabilities.title: presence
capabilities.summary: Presence / who's-online.

routes.desc: members online in the last N min (profiles)

capabilities.title: PRICE LISTS
capabilities.summary: tiered / customer-group pricing with volume breaks. A lookup returns the best price whose min_qty is ≤ the requested quantity, within the named list (e.g. 'retail', 'wholesale', 'vip').

routes.desc: {list, item, price, currency?, min_qty?}  (ADMIN) → upsert a tier

capabilities.title: PROFANITY FILTER
capabilities.summary: an admin manages a blocklist of words; anyone checks text against it and gets back a clean flag, the matched words, and a masked version.

capabilities.title: promotions
capabilities.summary: PROMOTIONS / PROMO ENGINE (commerce) — a richer promo engine (distinct from the basic /coupons): server-computed discount + rules. Manage + redeem = ADMIN (server-authoritative); validate (preview) = any member.

routes.desc: {code, kind:'percent'|'fixed'|'free_shipping', value?, min_order?, max_uses?, per_user_max?, starts?, expires?, active?}  (admin) upsert

capabilities.title: PRORATION
capabilities.summary: a stateless subscription-change proration calculator. Given the old + new price and the billing period, it returns the unused credit from the old plan and the prorated charge for the new plan over the remaining days, and the net amount to charge now (negative = a credit). Money in cents.

capabilities.title: PUBLISH SCHEDULING QUEUE
capabilities.summary: an admin schedules a content item (by ref) to go live at a time; a due-list surfaces items past their publish_at to actually publish.

routes.desc: (ADMIN) → scheduled items whose time has passed

capabilities.title: LOYALTY PUNCH CARDS
capabilities.summary: a 'buy N, get 1 free' stamp card. A punch bumps a monotonic total; earned rewards = total ÷ needed and available = earned − redeemed (all integer math, so no rounding). Admin defines + stamps; a member reads their card and redeems a free reward.

routes.desc: {key, punches_needed, title?, reward?}   (ADMIN) → define a program

capabilities.title: QR PAYLOAD BUILDER
capabilities.summary: a stateless helper that assembles the STRING to encode in a QR code (url / text / wifi / geo / tel / sms / mailto / vcard). The client passes `payload` to any QR-rendering library.

capabilities.title: QUEST CHAINS
capabilities.summary: an ordered list of steps a member completes strictly in sequence; progress advances one step at a time (an out-of-order or repeat step is refused). Admin defines; members play.

capabilities.title: queue
capabilities.summary: QUEUE / TICKET DISPENSER (deli counter) — take a monotonic ticket number, an operator calls the next, and anyone sees who's now serving.

routes.desc: (ADMIN) → advance to the next waiting ticket

capabilities.title: quizzes
capabilities.summary: QUIZ / ASSESSMENT AUTO-GRADING (LMS) — server-side answer keys (never shown to takers) + auto-grading + attempt history. Define = ADMIN; grade = any signed-in member.

routes.desc: list / one (answers only shown to admin)

capabilities.title: QUOTE / ESTIMATE BUILDER
capabilities.summary: an admin builds a quote of line items (qty × unit price), the server totals it, and the customer views/accepts it via a share token.

routes.desc: {number?, customer?, currency?, notes?, expires?, lines:[{description, qty?, unit}]}  (ADMIN) → {id, number, token}

capabilities.title: ranked-vote
capabilities.summary: RANKED-CHOICE VOTING (instant runoff) — a member submits an ordered ranking of candidates; results eliminate the lowest first-choice each round, redistributing to the next preference, until one has a majority. Admin creates; members rank once (re-rank replaces).

capabilities.title: RATE-LIMIT POLICIES
capabilities.summary: an admin declares named per-key limits (max hits per window); `consume` atomically counts a hit in the current fixed window and reports whether it's allowed + how many remain.

capabilities.title: STAR RATINGS
capabilities.summary: a quick 1–5 star rating per item, one changeable vote per member; the average, count, and distribution are derived. Distinct from text /reviews.

capabilities.title: react
capabilities.summary: Reactions — one-per-user likes / upvotes / RSVPs / emoji. GET reads counts (+ the caller's own reactions if signed in); POST toggles the caller's reaction of a given type and returns {reacted, count}.

capabilities.title: READ RECEIPTS
capabilities.summary: track who has read a given message/resource (group messages, announcements, docs). A member marks a message read (idempotent); the sender/admin sees the reader list, a member sees the count + whether they've read it.

capabilities.title: READABILITY
capabilities.summary: a stateless text analyzer: word / sentence / syllable counts, reading time, and Flesch reading-ease + Flesch-Kincaid grade level.

capabilities.title: RECENTLY-VIEWED
capabilities.summary: a per-member ring of the rows they last looked at (recently-viewed products, recent docs). Re-viewing bumps a row to the top; the ring is pruned to the last 200 per member.

capabilities.title: recurring
capabilities.summary: RECURRING EVENTS (RRULE-lite) — a STATELESS expander: given a start + a simple recurrence rule + a window, return the occurrence dates. freq daily|weekly|monthly; interval, count, until, byweekday.

routes.desc: {start, freq, interval?, count?, until?, byweekday?, from?, to?, limit?}

capabilities.title: RECYCLE BIN
capabilities.summary: a soft-delete store: an admin stashes a JSON snapshot of a deleted record, then restores or purges it. Restore returns the snapshot AND removes it from the bin (the app re-inserts the data).

routes.desc: (ADMIN) → purge everything older than a date

capabilities.title: REDIRECTS
capabilities.summary: an admin maps an old path → a new URL (301/302); the app resolves a path at runtime and the hit is counted. Managing is admin; resolve is public.

capabilities.title: REFERRAL TRACKING + ATTRIBUTION
capabilities.summary: every member has a stable referral code; a new member claims a code ONCE to attribute themselves to a referrer; a leaderboard ranks top referrers. → {referrer_id} · 400 self/blank · 404 unknown code · 409 already claimed

routes.desc: {code}  → attribute me to the code's owner, ONCE

capabilities.title: RELATED CONTENT
capabilities.summary: a STATELESS recommender: given a set of items with tags and a target id, rank the others by how many tags they share with the target.

capabilities.title: REMINDERS
capabilities.summary: per-member scheduled notes; the app POLLS /due for ones that have come due. Every reminder is PRIVATE to its owner (every query filters user_id=?, so another member's id 404s and never leaks). remind_at is normalized to a canonical ISO string on write so /due compares cleanly.

capabilities.title: RENEWALS
capabilities.summary: contract / subscription end-date tracking with an 'upcoming' window and a renew action. Admin.

routes.desc: (ADMIN) → active renewals ending within the window

capabilities.title: report
capabilities.summary: Content reports / flags + moderation queue.

capabilities.title: reputation
capabilities.summary: REPUTATION / KARMA (time-decayed) — each award is a timestamped event; the score is the sum of points weighted by an exponential half-life, so old reputation fades. Admin awards; members read.

capabilities.title: SLUG / HANDLE RESERVATION
capabilities.summary: atomically claim a unique name within a namespace, first-come-first-served.

capabilities.title: RETENTION COHORTS
capabilities.summary: of the actors first seen in a period, how many came back in each later period. Computed over the app's OWN event-log table (any row = "active that day"). Each actor is cohorted by the period of their FIRST event; the grid then shows, per cohort, the % still active at each subsequent offset (0 = the cohort period itself). → {period, offsets, cohorts:[{cohort, size, retention:[{offset, count, pct}]}], overall:[…]} ADMIN site-user only (reads across every actor's rows).

capabilities.title: RATINGS & REVIEWS
capabilities.summary: one review per member per subject (a product id, listing slug, any key); re-submitting UPSERTS. Reads are PUBLIC (a reviews widget renders to anyone); writing/deleting your own needs a site-user token, and an admin may delete anyone's to moderate.

routes.desc: {subject, rating(1-5), title?, body?}  → upsert my review

capabilities.title: REWARDS CATALOG
capabilities.summary: an admin lists rewards (a points cost, optional stock); a member redeems by spending their gamification points (from /points). Stock is claimed then points deducted (refunded on a points shortfall), so neither over-sells nor overdraws. PATCH/DELETE /api/db/<slug>/rewards-catalog/<id> (ADMIN)

capabilities.title: RETURN / RMA FLOW
capabilities.summary: a member requests a return against an order; an admin moves it through requested → approved | rejected, and approved → refunded. Each transition is an atomic state-guarded UPDATE.

capabilities.title: ROLLING UNIQUES
capabilities.summary: an exact distinct-value counter per stream (unique visitors, devices, coupon uses…). A signed-in member records a value (deduped); anyone can read the distinct count, optionally within a window.

capabilities.title: ROMAN
capabilities.summary: a stateless Roman-numeral converter, both directions (1..3999).

capabilities.title: RESOURCE / ROOM DOUBLE-BOOK CALENDAR
capabilities.summary: book a resource for a window; overlapping bookings for the same resource are rejected atomically.

capabilities.title: rows
capabilities.summary: BULK UPDATE / DELETE by filter — apply one change to every row matching a filter, in a single statement ("archive all completed", "delete all drafts"). ADMIN-only + a filter is REQUIRED (no accidental whole-table wipe unless you pass all:true) + affected rows are capped. On a trash table, bulk delete SOFT-deletes (consistent with a single delete). → {op, affected}

capabilities.title: RRULE EXPANSION
capabilities.summary: a stateless recurrence expander: from a start date + a simple rule (freq / interval / count / until / weekly byday) return the next occurrence dates. A lightweight subset of iCal RRULE.

capabilities.title: SALES QUOTA
capabilities.summary: per-rep, per-period target + running attainment (both in cents; `rep` is a free label).

capabilities.title: saves
capabilities.summary: Bookmarks / saves — a member's private "saved" list over any row (`<table>:<id>`).

capabilities.title: SCHEDULE REGISTRY
capabilities.summary: declare named recurring schedules (an interval in seconds); mark each run and poll which are due (enabled AND last_run + interval ≤ now). A lightweight cron-style registry.

capabilities.title: searches
capabilities.summary: SAVED SEARCHES (per-member) — a member saves a named {table, query} and re-RUNs it to get matching rows UNDER THEIR OWN read scope (own rows on a `user` table, public rows on display/feed/admin, refused on write-only `collect`; trashed/expired/unpublished/archived rows always hidden). Private per member — GET/RUN/DELETE only ever touch the caller's own rows.

capabilities.title: SEAT MAP
capabilities.summary: reserve individual seats from a named layout. Claiming a taken seat fails atomically; a group reserve is all-or-nothing (any conflict rolls back the ones just claimed). A member holds their own seats.

capabilities.title: SAVED SEGMENTS / AUDIENCES
capabilities.summary: a named admin filter over a table ("active users", "big spenders") you can re-count and preview on demand. The filter reuses the list read's where/q/sort grammar (stored as a query string); evaluation runs as admin over ALL rows.

capabilities.title: SENTIMENT
capabilities.summary: a stateless lexicon sentiment scorer (AFINN-lite) with simple negation handling: returns a total score, a per-word comparative, a label, and the matched positive/negative words.

capabilities.title: seo
capabilities.summary: SEO METADATA per record — an admin stores title/description/og-image/canonical/keywords for a (entity, ref) pair (e.g. entity='product', ref='42', or a bare path); the app reads it to render <head> tags. Reading is public; writing is admin.

routes.desc: {entity, ref, title?, description?, image?, canonical?, keywords?}  (ADMIN) → upsert

capabilities.title: DRIP SEQUENCES
capabilities.summary: an admin defines an ordered set of steps (each with a day-offset from enrollment); a subject is enrolled and each step comes due at enrolled_at + day. A worker sends due steps + advances.

routes.desc: (ADMIN) → enrollments whose next step is due (+ the step)
{enrollment}  (ADMIN) → mark the step sent, move to next

capabilities.title: SERVICE CATALOG
capabilities.summary: a bookable/sellable service list (name × duration × price × category).

routes.desc: {name, description?, duration?, price?, currency?, category?, active?, position?}  (ADMIN) → {id}

capabilities.title: ANALYTICS SESSIONS
capabilities.summary: a member opens a session, heartbeats it (bumping last_seen + page views), and ends it; an admin counts who's active in a recent window.

capabilities.title: PER-MEMBER SETTINGS
capabilities.summary: an arbitrary key→value store each member keeps for themselves (theme, saved UI layout, app-defined preferences). Private per member. Distinct from the public site /config and the specific /notify-prefs. Values are any JSON.

capabilities.title: SOCIAL SHARE COUNTERS
capabilities.summary: per-URL per-network share tallies (a "shared N times" widget).

capabilities.title: STAFF SHIFTS
capabilities.summary: an admin schedules staff shifts (who, when, role); a coverage check counts who is on during a window.

capabilities.title: SHIPPING-RATE CALCULATOR
capabilities.summary: an admin defines rate tiers per named zone (weight and/or subtotal bands, a flat rate, an optional free-over threshold); the app asks for a quote and gets the matching rate.

routes.desc: {zone, label?, min_weight?, max_weight?, min_subtotal?, max_subtotal?, rate, free_over?}  (ADMIN) → {id}

capabilities.title: SLA TIMERS
capabilities.summary: start a deadline clock for a (kind, ref) with a target in minutes; reads report remaining / breached; resolving stops the clock.

capabilities.title: SLOT CHECK
capabilities.summary: a stateless appointment-availability test. Given a proposed slot, a list of busy intervals, and an optional buffer, it reports whether the slot is free (the buffer is added on BOTH sides of the proposal) and lists any conflicts.

capabilities.title: slots
capabilities.summary: CAPACITY TIME-SLOTS (class sizes) — a fixed-capacity session members book a seat in; the cap can't be exceeded under concurrency. Distinct from /bookings (1:1 appointments).

capabilities.title: SLUGIFY
capabilities.summary: a stateless URL-slug generator: lowercase, transliterate common accents, replace runs of non-alphanumerics with a separator, trim, cap length; an optional `existing` list appends -2/-3 on collision.

capabilities.title: REUSABLE CONTENT SNIPPETS / BLOCKS
capabilities.summary: an admin stores named chunks of content (a promo banner, a footer blurb, boilerplate T&Cs) keyed by slug; the app reads a published one, the admin lists all.

capabilities.title: SPAM / HONEYPOT SCORE
capabilities.summary: a stateless heuristic scorer for a form submission: a filled honeypot field, a suspiciously fast submit, too many links, shouting, and known spam words each add to a 0–100 score. → {score, verdict: 'ham'|'suspect'|'spam', reasons:[...]}

capabilities.title: SPLIT AMOUNT
capabilities.summary: a stateless fair money splitter: divide an amount into N equal shares (or by weights) with cents distributed by largest-remainder, so the shares sum EXACTLY to the amount.

capabilities.title: SPOTLIGHT
capabilities.summary: a rotating featured pool: an admin adds items with a weight; the "current" endpoint returns a deterministic weighted pick that rotates by day (no server-side "current" state).

capabilities.title: A/B SIGNIFICANCE HELPER
capabilities.summary: a stateless two-proportion z-test: given each variant's visitors + conversions, returns the rates, uplift, z-score, two-tailed p-value, and whether it's significant.

capabilities.title: stock
capabilities.summary: STOCK LEDGER (ERP inventory) — append-only movements; on-hand = Σqty; reservations earmark availability. No-negative-stock is enforced atomically. ADMIN-gated.

routes.desc: {item, location?, qty(+recv/−issue), kind?, ref?, unit_cost?, allowNegative?} → {move, level}
{item, from, to, qty, ref?}    → guarded issue+receipt across locations
{item, location?, qty, ref?}    → {reservation, level} (409 if oversell)
issue the reserved qty + close it
items at/below reorder point + suggested qty

capabilities.title: STORE-CREDIT LEDGER
capabilities.summary: an admin issues store credit to a member; the member redeems it (never below zero). Append-only, balance = SUM(delta). Distinct from the transferable /wallet.

routes.desc: {amount, ref?}  (member) → deduct own balance → {balance} · 409 if short

capabilities.title: streak
capabilities.summary: DAILY CHECK-IN STREAKS (habit / gamification) — a member checks in at most ONCE per UTC day (a composite-PK atomic INSERT...WHERE NOT EXISTS; a 2nd check-in the same day is a no-op, not an error), and reads their current + longest streak. current = the consecutive run ending today or yesterday; longest = the max run ever. All per-member (no cross-member surface).

capabilities.title: STRING SIMILARITY
capabilities.summary: a stateless fuzzy-match helper: Levenshtein edit distance, a 0–1 normalized similarity, and the Sørensen–Dice bigram coefficient between two strings. For dedupe / typo tolerance.

capabilities.title: RECURRING-ORDER SUBSCRIPTIONS
capabilities.summary: a member subscribes to a cadence; next_run advances by interval_days.

routes.desc: (ADMIN) → bump next_run by interval, count a run

capabilities.title: SURVEYS / NPS / CSAT
capabilities.summary: one numeric response per member per survey (re-submit upserts). A member submits + reads THEIR OWN; the aggregate + individual responses are ADMIN (they expose others' scores). The aggregate KIND is a read-time lens over the raw scores.

capabilities.title: CONTENT SYNDICATION
capabilities.summary: an admin registers published URLs; the site serves them as a sitemap.xml and an rss.xml feed. Managing is admin; the feeds are public XML.

routes.desc: {url, title?, summary?, published?, changed?, priority?}  (ADMIN) → upsert

capabilities.title: TAX-EXEMPTION REGISTRY
capabilities.summary: one certificate per customer key, with an optional region + expiry. The check reports whether the customer is CURRENTLY exempt (an expired certificate reads as not-exempt).

capabilities.title: TAX RATES
capabilities.summary: an admin stores a tax rate per region; the app computes the tax on a subtotal.

routes.desc: {rate, name?}  (ADMIN) → set (rate as a percent, e.g. 8.75)

capabilities.title: TAXONOMY
capabilities.summary: a nested term tree (categories / topics / hierarchical tags). Terms hang off a parent_id; the full tree is assembled server-side. Admin edits; anyone reads.

routes.desc: {term, parent?, slug?, position?}   (ADMIN) → add a term

capabilities.title: TEAMS / ORGANIZATIONS / WORKSPACES
capabilities.summary: group members into teams with a role each. The foundation for B2B/multi-tenant apps: a shared workspace, a project team, an org account. Per-team settings / config KV (each workspace configures itself — branding, prefs, flags). Any member READS; owner/admin WRITE. Values are JSON. Separate from the site-wide /config.

capabilities.title: TEMPLATE RENDER
capabilities.summary: a stateless mustache-lite renderer: {{key}} (HTML-escaped), {{{key}}} (raw), {{#key}}…{{/key}} (sections / array iteration with {{.}}), {{^key}}…{{/key}} (inverted). Dot paths.

capabilities.title: TERMS ACCEPTANCE
capabilities.summary: an admin publishes a versioned document; a member accepts the current version and the app checks whether they're up to date.

routes.desc: {version, title?, url?, body?}  (ADMIN) → set the current version
(member) → record acceptance of the current version

capabilities.title: TERRITORY RULES
capabilities.summary: named territories with match rules; a `match` call routes an input (a lead/account) to the highest-priority territory whose rules ALL fit. Rules are a JSON object; each key lists allowed values (postal is PREFIX-matched via `postal_prefix`); a territory with no rules is a catch-all.

capabilities.title: TESTIMONIALS
capabilities.summary: a curated wall of marketing quotes. Anyone signed in submits a quote (unapproved); an admin approves / features / reorders it; the public list returns only approved ones (featured first).

capabilities.title: SUPPORT TICKETS
capabilities.summary: a member opens a ticket, staff (admin) triage/assign/resolve, both reply on a thread; an `internal` message is a staff-only note the requester never sees.

capabilities.title: timeclock
capabilities.summary: TIME & ATTENDANCE / CLOCK (HRMS) — clock in/out → worked hours. A signed-in member clocks themselves (employee = their id); an admin can act for any `employee`.

routes.desc: {employee?, at?, note?}   → open a shift (409 if already in)
{employee?, clock_in, clock_out, note?}  (admin) → add a completed shift
total hours (per employee if unscoped, admin)

capabilities.title: TIME-OFF REQUESTS
capabilities.summary: a member requests time off; an admin approves/denies. Distinct from the /leave balance ledger — this is the request→decision workflow.

capabilities.title: TABLE OF CONTENTS / ANCHOR INDEX
capabilities.summary: a stateless extractor: given HTML or Markdown, pull the headings into a flat list + a nested tree, each with a slugified anchor id (deduped).

capabilities.title: track
capabilities.summary: Visitor analytics — a built app records a page view or custom event. Public, fire-and-forget, buffered (never blocks). Rate-limited.

capabilities.title: EMAIL OPEN/CLICK TRACKING
capabilities.summary: a 1×1 pixel logs an open and a click-redirect logs a click, both keyed by (campaign, recipient); the admin reads open/click/CTR stats.

capabilities.title: TRENDING / TOP-N
capabilities.summary: a rolling popularity feed: each hit records an item (+ optional weight) with a timestamp, and `top` aggregates the highest-scoring items inside a time window.

capabilities.title: upload
capabilities.summary: File upload to R2 (per-app, consistent with the /api/db/<slug>/* API). Base64 data URL in, a permanent public URL out. Images (PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF) + PDF, ≤6MB. Same store + serve (/u/<slug>/…) as the platform uploader; only stores for a REAL live site.

capabilities.title: USAGE METERING
capabilities.summary: cumulative counters per (meter, period): each record bumps a count and adds to a total, for billing / usage dashboards. Distinct from the windowed enforcement of /rate-policies.

capabilities.title: UTM CAMPAIGN LINKS
capabilities.summary: an admin registers a tracked outbound link (target URL + campaign/source/medium); the returned tracking URL carries the utm_* params, each hit bumps a counter, and a report rolls the clicks up by campaign/source/medium.

routes.desc: {target, campaign?, source?, medium?, term?, content?, slug?}  (ADMIN)

capabilities.title: VAT NUMBER
capabilities.summary: a stateless EU (+ UK) VAT-number FORMAT validator (structure only, not a live VIES lookup).

capabilities.title: VAULT
capabilities.summary: an admin-only key-value store for app config / secrets. Every operation is admin-only. POST/PUT /api/db/<slug>/vault/<key> {value, note?} (ADMIN) → set

capabilities.title: vcard
capabilities.summary: vCARD — a stateless generator: turn contact fields into a downloadable .vcf (vCard 3.0) for an 'add to contacts' / 'save my details' button. (public) → text/vcard

routes.desc: {name, first?, last?, email?, phone?, org?, title?, url?, note?}

capabilities.title: views
capabilities.summary: Saved views / filters (private per member) — a named JSON query config.

capabilities.title: WAITLIST / QUEUE
capabilities.summary: a fair FIFO queue per named list. A member JOINS once (a strictly-increasing `seq` is assigned by a SINGLE atomic INSERT...SELECT with seq = MAX(seq)+1, guarded by WHERE NOT EXISTS so a re-join changes 0 rows), sees their live POSITION (count of still-'waiting' rows with a smaller seq, +1), or LEAVES. An admin views the ordered queue + counts and CLAIMs the front (or a named user) — a SINGLE atomic guarded UPDATE (seq = the current MIN waiting seq) flips them out of 'waiting', so concurrent claim-front calls drain DIFFERENT members, never double-claim, and everyone behind advances (position counts only 'waiting' rows).

routes.desc: {status, position, seq} · 404 if not on it
remove myself · 404 if not on it
{user?, as?} → (ADMIN) claim front or a named user

capabilities.title: WAIVERS
capabilities.summary: a member e-signs a versioned waiver (name + signature text); an admin reads the signatures.

routes.desc: (member) → have I signed the current version?

capabilities.title: WALLET / POINTS / STORE CREDIT
capabilities.summary: a generic guarded balance per (account, currency). Writes are ADMIN (server-authoritative — users can't credit themselves); a member reads their OWN balance/history; an admin reads anyone's.

routes.desc: {account, currency?, amount(+credit/−debit), kind?, ref?, note?, allowNegative?}  (admin)

capabilities.title: WEBHOOK DEAD-LETTER + RETRY
capabilities.summary: inspect failed deliveries and re-fire one. Additive to /webhooks; the existing /webhooks(?:/emit|/deliveries|/<id>)? matcher doesn't catch these deeper paths.

routes.desc: {url, events?, secret?}   → register (admin; url must be https)

capabilities.title: WIN/LOSS REASONS
capabilities.summary: log a deal outcome (won/lost) with a reason + amount; the summary rolls up win rate, value, and a breakdown by reason.

capabilities.title: WISHLIST / SAVED ITEMS
capabilities.summary: a member saves items; a per-item want-count is derived.

routes.desc: (public) → how many members saved it (+ mine)

capabilities.title: WORD FREQUENCY
capabilities.summary: a stateless top-terms counter over a block of text (lower-cased, split on non-letters), with optional stop-word removal and a `top` cap.

capabilities.title: work-orders
capabilities.summary: WORK ORDERS (ERP manufacturing) — build a quantity of a product from its BOM. ADMIN.

routes.desc: {product, qty, location?, ref?, notes?} → plan a build
